deadline.value: Fall: Jan. 1 (for special funding opportunities); March 1 (for full funding opportunities); April 1 (final)
deadline.quote: Fall: Jan. 1 (for special funding opportunities); March 1 (for full funding opportunities); April 1 (final)

gre_subject.value: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study; ETS offers no Computer Science subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: Students appointed as assistants, graduate fellows and graduate part-time lecturers receive tuition waivers in addition to their stipends during the period of their appointment.
funding.quote: Tuition Waivers: Students appointed as assistants, graduate fellows and graduate part-time lecturers receive tuition waivers in addition to their stipends during the period of their appointment.

entry_route.value: A Ph.D. student who has previously completed a Masters degree must take classes from at least three faculty; all other students must take classes from at least five faculty.
entry_route.quote: To satisfy this requirement, a Ph.D. student who has previously completed a Masters degree, must take classes from at least three different faculty. All other students must take classes from at least five different faculty.

gre_general.value: GRE General test scores are normally required but may be waived for students who have taken computer science courses at UNH.
gre_general.quote: GRE General test scores are normally required but may be waived for students who have taken computer science courses at UNH.
